scenario: A wallpaper app runs a hidden cryptomining process in the background.

supported_findings: A WAKE_LOCK permission combined with a component named MiningWorkerService and strings referencing a mining pool connection and hashrate reporting is consistent with background cryptomining.
Recurring hourly connections to pool.example.com with similar byte counts (2200, 2100, 2300 bytes) are consistent with periodic mining-pool check-ins.
A string (cpu_throttle_disable) suggests the app is designed to avoid CPU throttling, which would otherwise limit mining performance.
unsupported_claims_to_watch_for: Any claim that a specific amount of cryptocurrency was mined or that a specific wallet address received funds -- no such data appears in this case.
Any claim that the device owner was aware of or consented to this activity -- the case contains no evidence about user awareness.
Any claim attributing battery drain or a specific financial loss to a named person.
